Three test files pin the catalog, one assertion each:

1. **`pi-repo/packages/self-learning/test/subagent-catalog.test.ts`** (unit level) —
   `expect(block!.startsWith("<advertised_subagents>")).toBe(true)` — asserts `renderAdvertisedCatalog` emits the XML wrapper and skips unadvertised agents (`- name: planner`).

2. **`pi-repo/packages/self-learning/test/tools.test.ts`** (injection level) —
   `expect(result!.systemPrompt.includes("<advertised_subagents>")).toBe(true)` — asserts `before_agent_start` appends the catalog (with `- name: general`, `- name: scout`) to the system prompt, and that `UNOWN_DELEGATION_LEVEL=never` withdraws it.

3. **`pi-repo/packages/self-learning/test/subagent-builtins.test.ts`** (agent-shape level) —
   `expect(planner.advertise).toBe(false)` — asserts which `ROLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS` appear in `renderAdvertisedCatalog(ROLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS, "standard")` (planner excluded, browser included).
